85:1.text: By the heaven holding the big stars.

85:3.text: [i.e. the day of ‘Arafât (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah]

85:4.text: Cursed were the people of the Ditch
(in the story of the Boy and the King)

85:7.text: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers

85:8.text: And they had no fault except that they believed in Allâh, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!

85:9.text: To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allâh is Witness over everything.

85:10.text: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women
, and then do not turn in repentance
, then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.

85:11.text: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow

85:12.text: of your Lord is severe and painful.

85:13.text: Verily, He it is Who begins
(or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection)

85:14.text: And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love
(towards the pious who are real true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)

85:15.text: Owner of the throne, the Glorious,

85:17.text: Has the story reached you of the hosts,

85:19.text: (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his Message of Islâmic Monotheism)

85:20.text: And Allâh encompasses them from behind!
(i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds)

85:21.text: Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’ân,
